title: Multitask Interactions in Recurrent Dynamics across 100 Cognitive Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.33926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The brain continually learns tasks with very different computational demands. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been used as dynamical surrogates for studying task solutions, with recent work extending this approach to joint training on multitask batteries. However, it remains unclear how tasks interact as these batteries grow in scale and heterogeneity: under what conditions do they transfer or interfere with one another, and how do these effects relate to task complexity and model structure? We study this question by simultaneously training hierarchical Almost-Linear RNNs (AL-RNNs) on 100 tasks spanning a wide range of cognitive demands. AL-RNNs allow us to vary the amount of nonlinearity in the recurrence, while hierarchical task features provide a low-dimensional interface for task-specific adaptation within shared dynamics. On this task battery, performance improves with both nonlinear capacity and task-feature dimensionality,

translated_title: 跨越100个认知任务的循环动力学中的多任务交互
translated_abstract: 大脑能够持续学习计算需求截然不同的任务。循环神经网络（RNN）已被用作研究任务解决方案的动力学替代模型，近期的工作更是将该方法扩展到在多任务集合上进行联合训练。然而，随着任务集合在规模和异质性上的不断增长，任务之间如何相互作用仍不清楚：在何种条件下任务之间会发生迁移或干扰？这些效应又如何与任务复杂性和模型结构相关联？我们通过在涵盖广泛认知需求的100个任务上同时训练分层近线性循环神经网络（AL-RNN）来研究这一问题。AL-RNN使我们能够调节循环中的非线性程度，而分层任务特征则为共享动力学中针对特定任务的适应提供了低维接口。在该任务集合上，性能随着非线性容量和任务特征维度的提升而提升……
tldr: 该研究通过在100个认知任务上联合训练可调节非线性的分层近线性循环神经网络，揭示了多任务训练中任务迁移与干扰的发生条件及其与任务复杂度、任务特征维度和模型非线性程度的关系。
en_tdlr: By jointly training hierarchical Almost-Linear RNNs with tunable nonlinearity on 100 cognitive tasks, this work reveals the conditions under which tasks transfer or interfere with one another, and how these effects depend on task complexity, task-feature dimensionality, and model nonlinearity.
